name: 置中堆疊：標誌＋圖示連結＋文字連結列＋底部列
desc: 所有元素置中、由上往下堆疊的頁尾，中段是橫向文字連結列，底部列上方有一條橫跨畫面的分隔線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。所有元素水平置中，由上往下堆疊：最上方是標誌，為頁尾裡最大的元素；其下是一排小圖示連結。再往下是一列橫向排列的文字連結，下方可再放一列較小的文字連結，連結之間以短直線分隔，沒有時省略。小字連結下方可放一排等大的小圖示，沒有時省略，其他元素位置不變。最下方是底部列：一行小字置中，上方有一條橫跨整個畫面寬、貼齊畫面左右邊緣的分隔線。
mobile: 仍然全部置中、由上往下堆疊，順序不變。橫向排列的文字連結改為直向堆疊，每個連結一行，全部展開；較小的文字連結不縮成一行，而是自動換成多行，每行置中，連結之間仍以短直線分隔。小圖示仍排成一列。底部列的分隔線保留並橫跨畫面寬，一行小字置中。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Centered stack: logo + icon links + text link rows + bottom bar
en.desc: A footer with every element centered and stacked top to bottom, a horizontal row of text links in the middle, and a full-width divider above the bottom bar.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. All elements are horizontally centered and stacked top to bottom: the logo sits at the top and is the largest element in the footer; below it is a row of small icon links. Further down is a horizontal row of text links; optionally place a row of smaller text links below it, separated by short vertical lines, and omit it when there is no content. Optionally place a row of equally sized small icons below the smaller text links; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. At the very bottom is the bottom bar: a line of small text centered, with a divider above it spanning the full viewport width, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport.
en.mobile: Everything stays centered and stacked top to bottom in the same order. The horizontal row of text links becomes a vertical stack with one link per line, all expanded; the smaller text links are not squeezed into a single line; they wrap onto multiple lines, each line centered, with short vertical lines still separating the links. The small icons remain in a single row. The bottom bar's divider is kept and still spans the full viewport width, with the line of small text centered. There is no motion.
